_comment: Shipped defaults: the floor of the configuration fallback ladder.
Used on a cold start when nothing has ever been cached and the server cannot be reached.
Every experiment the build knows about is declared here, and every one of them is 'stopped',
so this payload resolves to the control experience for everybody. Declaring them rather than
shipping an empty list is the point: a screen that asks about an experiment gets a definite
'not running' instead of a blank, and the demo's metrics panel has rows to draw before the
Keep this in step with the server config's layers and variant ids. ShippedDefaultsTests parses
and validates this exact file, so a typo here fails the build's test suite rather than only
showing up on an offline first launch.
